title: Quiet artists
statementMd:
List artists whose tracks together have fewer than 30 plays (include zero). Show name and plays.

Expected columns: `name`, `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Left join through albums and tracks.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ar.name, COUNT(p.id) AS plays FROM artists ar LEFT JOIN albums al ON al.artist_id = ar.id LEFT JOIN tracks t ON t.album_id = al.id LEFT JOIN plays p ON p.track_id = t.id GROUP BY ar.id, ar.name HAVING COUNT(p.id) < 30;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
